experiment_data.hypothesis: D&R hard filtering baseline with CORRECT filtered data (q≤0.5, 153725 samples, 86.4% real). Full 6103-step linear schedule. Paired with adaptive reweighting to compare hard filtering vs soft reweighting approaches. If D&R PPL > adaptive, soft reweighting extracts more value from contaminated data than simply removing it.
